about: The releases of Orkcraft, newest first: what an installed copy reads to update itself (docs/updates.md). A release marked critical installs by itself when the town opens.

releases.notes: Your mascot is drawn for your role: eleven heads, each growing its own headgear stage by stage (a keyword tag and rating stars for the ASO gnome, a megaphone and a growth arrow for the marketing one).
Orkcraft updates itself: critical fixes install by themselves when the town opens, other updates are offered.
